name: nodejs-installation
description: Guide for installing Node.js and resolving related issues.
problem: Node.js is not installed or not recognized in PATH

steps: Check if Node.js is installed using `node --version`
If not installed, use `winget install OpenJS.NodeJS` to install Node.js
Alternatively, download and install the LTS version from https://nodejs.org/
Verify the installation by running `node --version` and `npm --version`
Ensure the PATH environment variable includes Node.js installation directory
